decisions.choice: answered and said: the usual opening of a speech
decisions.reason: "He answered and said" opens each speech in the dialogue (3:2; 6:1). Job answers Bildad's short speech of chapter 25.

decisions.choice: how far Job's speech runs: through chapter 31, though 27:1 and 29:1 open new parts
decisions.reason: In the book as it stands Job speaks from here to the end of chapter 31; 27:1 and 29:1 add a new heading ("Job again took up his discourse"). Because Bildad's speech is so short and Zophar has no third speech, some think parts of chapters 26 and 27 once belonged to the friends (see 26:5). The text gives these words to Job.

decisions.choice: answered (B) / said (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use one English verb for the Hebrew pair, as in the other speech introductions of Job. The introduction stays prose.

records.literal_gloss: How you have helped [one with] no power! [How] you have saved [the] arm [with] no strength!

en.L: How you have helped [one with] no power! \q [How] you have saved [the] arm [with] no strength!
en.B: How you have helped the powerless! \q How you have saved the arm that has no strength!
en.R: What a help you have been to someone who is weak! \q What a rescue for someone who has no strength!

es.L: ¡Cómo has ayudado al [que] no [tiene] poder! \q ¡[Cómo] has salvado al brazo [que] no [tiene] fuerza!
es.B: ¡Cómo has ayudado al que no tiene poder! \q ¡Cómo has salvado al brazo sin fuerza!
es.R: ¡Qué gran ayuda has sido para el débil! \q ¡Qué rescate para el que no tiene fuerzas!

fr.L: Comme tu as aidé [celui qui est] sans pouvoir ! \q [Comme] tu as sauvé le bras sans force !
fr.B: Comme tu as aidé celui qui est sans pouvoir ! \q Comme tu as secouru le bras privé de vigueur !
fr.R: Quelle aide tu as été pour celui qui est faible ! \q Quel secours pour celui qui n’a plus de force !

sw.L: Jinsi ulivyomsaidia [yule asiye na] nguvu! \q [Jinsi] ulivyouokoa mkono [usio na] uwezo!
sw.B: Jinsi ulivyomsaidia asiye na nguvu! \q Jinsi ulivyouokoa mkono usio na uwezo!
sw.R: Umekuwa msaada mkubwa kweli kwa mtu dhaifu! \q Umemwokoa kweli mtu asiye na nguvu!

vi.L: Anh đã giúp đỡ [kẻ] không có sức mạnh biết bao! \q Anh đã cứu cánh tay không còn sức lực [biết bao]!
vi.B: Anh giúp đỡ kẻ yếu đuối hay biết bao! \q Anh cứu cánh tay không còn sức lực giỏi biết bao!
vi.R: Anh giúp người yếu đuối giỏi thật đấy! \q Anh cứu người kiệt sức hay thật đấy!

ko.L: 그대가 힘 없는 [자를] 얼마나 잘 도왔소! \q 기운 없는 팔을 [얼마나 잘] 구원했소!
ko.B: 그대는 힘없는 자를 참으로 잘도 도왔소! \q 기운 없는 팔을 참으로 잘도 구해 주었소!
ko.R: 약한 사람에게 그대는 정말 큰 도움이 되었구려! \q 힘없는 사람을 정말 잘도 건져 주었구려!

pt.L: Como você ajudou [quem não tem] força! \q [Como] você salvou o braço [que não tem] vigor!
pt.B: Como você ajudou o fraco! \q Como você salvou o braço sem forças!
pt.R: Que grande ajuda você deu a quem é fraco! \q Que belo socorro para quem não tem forças!

decisions.choice: biting irony: Bildad has helped no one
decisions.reason: Job's exclamations are sarcastic. Bildad claimed to speak for God, but his words gave no help to the weak man in front of him. The "you" is singular: Job answers Bildad (chapter 25).

decisions.choice: the arm: strength to act
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the arm stands for a person's power (22:8-9; Psalm 10:15). "An arm with no strength" is someone helpless, here Job himself.

decisions.choice: someone who is weak ... someone who has no strength
decisions.reason: Readable turns the picture of the arm into the person it stands for (m2) and keeps the ironic exclamations.

decisions.choice: "anh" (singular) for Bildad, with the ironic "biết bao" / "thật đấy"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'you' is singular: Job answers Bildad alone here (meaning decision m1). The exclamations keep the sarcasm of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 하오체 with 그대 where Job speaks to Bildad (verses 2-4); the plain style in the hymn of verses 5-14
decisions.reason: Verses 2-4 address Bildad directly (the 'you' is singular, meaning decision m1), so they keep the 하오체 used between Job and his friends. Verses 5-14 describe God's power without addressing anyone, and Korean sets such a poem in the plain written style.

decisions.choice: você, with ironic exclamations
decisions.reason: Job answers Bildad alone (the Hebrew "you" is singular, m1) and, as between the friends throughout the book, with "você" (JOB_NOTE). The irony is carried by the exclamations themselves; Readable adds the mock praise "Que grande", "Que belo", which Brazilian readers hear as sarcasm.

source.text: מַה־יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: How you have counseled [one with] no wisdom! And sound wisdom in abundance you have made known!

en.L: How you have counseled [one with] no wisdom, \q and made known sound wisdom in abundance!
en.B: How you have advised one who lacks wisdom, \q and shown such a wealth of insight!
en.R: What good advice you have given to someone with no wisdom! \q How much insight you have shared!

es.L: ¡Cómo has aconsejado al [que] no [tiene] sabiduría, \q y has dado a conocer cordura en abundancia!
es.B: ¡Cómo has aconsejado al que no tiene sabiduría, \q y qué riqueza de sensatez has mostrado!
es.R: ¡Qué buenos consejos le has dado a alguien sin sabiduría! \q ¡Cuánta inteligencia has compartido!

fr.L: Comme tu as conseillé [celui qui est] sans sagesse, \q et fait connaître le bon sens en abondance !
fr.B: Comme tu as conseillé celui qui manque de sagesse, \q et déployé une telle richesse de discernement !
fr.R: Quels bons conseils tu as donnés à quelqu’un sans sagesse ! \q Que de lumières tu as partagées !

sw.L: Jinsi ulivyomshauri [yule asiye na] hekima, \q na kujulisha busara kwa wingi!
sw.B: Jinsi ulivyomshauri asiye na hekima, \q na kuonyesha wingi kama huo wa busara!
sw.R: Umempa mtu asiye na hekima ushauri mzuri kweli! \q Umetoa maarifa mengi kweli!

vi.L: Anh đã khuyên bảo [kẻ] không có khôn ngoan biết bao, \q và tỏ ra sự thông sáng thật dư dật!
vi.B: Anh khuyên bảo kẻ thiếu khôn ngoan hay biết bao, \q và bày tỏ sự hiểu biết dồi dào biết bao!
vi.R: Anh khuyên người chẳng có khôn ngoan hay thật đấy! \q Anh chia sẻ bao nhiêu là hiểu biết!

ko.L: 그대가 지혜 없는 [자에게] 얼마나 잘 조언했소! \q 건전한 지혜를 풍성하게 알려 주었소!
ko.B: 그대는 지혜 없는 자에게 참으로 좋은 조언을 해 주었고, \q 그 많은 슬기를 잘도 보여 주었소!
ko.R: 지혜 없는 사람에게 그대는 정말 좋은 충고를 해 주었구려! \q 그대가 나눠 준 깨달음이 정말 많기도 하오!

pt.L: Como você aconselhou [quem não tem] sabedoria \q e deu a conhecer bom senso em abundância!
pt.B: Como você aconselhou quem não tem sabedoria \q e mostrou uma riqueza de discernimento!
pt.R: Que bons conselhos você deu a quem não tem sabedoria! \q Quanto discernimento você compartilhou!

decisions.choice: more irony: Bildad's counsel was empty
decisions.reason: Job goes on in the same sarcastic tone as verse 2. The "abundance" Bildad made known was five verses that only repeated what had been said before (25:4-6; compare 4:17; 15:14-16).

decisions.choice: sound wisdom: practical insight that leads to success
decisions.reason: The word (tushiyyah) means effective wisdom, the kind that works (5:12; 6:13; 11:6). Job says Bildad offered a great deal of it, and means he offered none.

decisions.choice: such a wealth of insight
decisions.reason: Balanced says "insight" for the second word for wisdom so the line does not repeat "wisdom", and "such a wealth" keeps the mock praise.

source.text: אֶת־מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: With whom have you told words? And the breath of whom has gone out from you?

en.L: With whom have you uttered words? \q And whose breath has gone out from you?
en.B: With whose help have you uttered these words? \q Whose spirit has spoken through you?
en.R: Who helped you say these things? \q Whose spirit was speaking through you?

es.L: ¿Con quién has pronunciado palabras? \q ¿Y de quién es el aliento que ha salido de ti?
es.B: ¿Con ayuda de quién has pronunciado estas palabras? \q ¿Qué espíritu ha hablado por medio de ti?
es.R: ¿Quién te ayudó a decir estas cosas? \q ¿Qué espíritu hablaba por medio de ti?

fr.L: Avec qui as-tu proféré des paroles ? \q Et le souffle de qui est sorti de toi ?
fr.B: Avec l’aide de qui as-tu prononcé ces paroles ? \q Quel esprit a parlé par ta bouche ?
fr.R: Qui t’a aidé à dire ces choses ? \q Quel esprit parlait à travers toi ?

sw.L: Umetamka maneno pamoja na nani? \q Na pumzi ya nani imetoka kwako?
sw.B: Kwa msaada wa nani umetamka maneno haya? \q Ni roho ya nani imesema kupitia kwako?
sw.R: Ni nani aliyekusaidia kusema mambo haya? \q Ni roho ya nani iliyokuwa ikisema kupitia kwako?

vi.L: Anh đã nói ra lời cùng với ai? \q Và hơi thở của ai đã ra từ anh?
vi.B: Nhờ ai giúp mà anh nói ra những lời này? \q Thần linh của ai đã nói qua anh?
vi.R: Ai đã giúp anh nói những điều ấy? \q Thần linh nào đã nói qua miệng anh?

ko.L: 그대는 누구와 함께 말을 했소? \q 누구의 숨이 그대에게서 나왔소?
ko.B: 그대는 누구의 도움으로 이런 말을 했소? \q 누구의 영이 그대를 통해 말했소?
ko.R: 누가 그대를 도와 이런 말을 하게 했소? \q 어떤 영이 그대를 통해 말하고 있었소?

pt.L: Com quem você proferiu palavras? \q E o fôlego de quem saiu de você?
pt.B: Com a ajuda de quem você pronunciou essas palavras? \q Que espírito falou por meio de você?
pt.R: Quem ajudou você a dizer essas coisas? \q Que espírito estava falando por meio de você?

decisions.choice: with whom: with whose help
decisions.reason: The word ('et) can mean "with" (by whose help) or mark the one spoken to (to whom). Set beside the second line, which asks whose breath came out of Bildad, it most likely asks who stood behind his words.

decisions.choice: breath: the breath or spirit that inspires speech
decisions.reason: The word (neshamah) is the breath of life (27:3; 32:8; 33:4), and can be the breath or spirit that moves a person to speak. Job asks mockingly whether some spirit spoke through Bildad, as Eliphaz claimed a spirit spoke to him (4:15-16). He implies that Bildad's words came from no one but himself.

decisions.choice: Whose spirit has spoken through you?
alternatives: Whose breath has gone out from you?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "spirit" and "spoken through" to make clear that the breath is what inspires the speech (m2). Literal keeps the picture of breath going out.

decisions.choice: Whose spirit was speaking through you?
alternatives: Whose breath has gone out from you?
decisions.reason: As Balanced (m2).

records.literal_gloss: The shades are made to tremble beneath [the] waters and those dwelling in them.

en.L: The shades writhe \q beneath [the] waters and those who dwell in them.
en.B: The spirits of the dead tremble, \q those beneath the waters and all who live there.
en.R: The dead shake with fear \q in the deep places under the waters, with all who live there.

es.L: Las sombras se retuercen \q debajo de [las] aguas y de los que habitan en ellas.
es.B: Los espíritus de los muertos tiemblan, \q los que están bajo las aguas y todos los que allí habitan.
es.R: Los muertos tiemblan de miedo \q en lo profundo, bajo las aguas, con todos los que viven allí.

fr.L: Les ombres frémissent \q sous [les] eaux et ceux qui les habitent.
fr.B: Les esprits des morts tremblent, \q ceux qui sont sous les eaux et tous ceux qui y vivent.
fr.R: Les morts tremblent de peur \q dans les profondeurs sous les eaux, avec tous ceux qui y vivent.

sw.L: Vivuli [vya wafu] vinagaagaa \q chini ya maji na wale wakaao ndani yake.
sw.B: Roho za wafu zinatetemeka, \q zile zilizo chini ya maji na wote wakaao huko.
sw.R: Wafu wanatetemeka kwa hofu \q vilindini chini ya maji, pamoja na wote wanaoishi huko.

vi.L: Các vong linh quằn quại \q bên dưới [các] dòng nước và những kẻ cư ngụ trong đó.
vi.B: Hồn người chết run sợ, \q những kẻ ở dưới nước sâu và mọi loài sống nơi ấy.
vi.R: Người chết run lên vì sợ \q nơi sâu thẳm dưới các dòng nước, cùng mọi loài sống ở đó.

ko.L: 죽은 혼령들이 \q 물과 그 속에 사는 것들 아래에서 몸부림친다.
ko.B: 죽은 자들의 영이 떨고 있다. \q 물 아래 있는 자들과 그곳에 사는 모든 것들이 떤다.
ko.R: 죽은 사람들이 두려워 떤다. \q 물 아래 깊은 곳에서, 그곳에 사는 모든 것과 함께.

pt.L: As sombras se contorcem \q debaixo das águas e dos que nelas habitam.
pt.B: Os espíritos dos mortos tremem, \q os que estão debaixo das águas e todos os que ali vivem.
pt.R: Os mortos tremem de medo \q nos lugares profundos debaixo das águas, com todos os que vivem ali.

decisions.choice: the shades: the dead in the world below
decisions.reason: The word (repha'im) names the shadowy dead in Sheol (Psalm 88:11; Proverbs 9:18; Isaiah 14:9). The same word is used elsewhere for a people of giants (Deuteronomy 2:11), but here, next to Sheol and Abaddon (verse 6), it means the dead.

decisions.choice: beneath the waters: the world of the dead under the deep
decisions.reason: In the Bible's picture of the world, the waters of the deep lie under the earth, and the realm of the dead lies deeper still (38:16-17). Even there God's power is felt and the dead tremble before him.

decisions.choice: Job takes up the theme of God's power in creation, 26:5-14
alternatives: these verses continue Bildad's speech of chapter 25
decisions.reason: Verses 5-14 praise God's power over the deep, the sky and the sea, much as Bildad praised it in 25:2-3. Because Bildad's speech is so short, some think these verses once belonged to it. In the text as it stands Job speaks them, and they fit his own praise of God's power in 9:5-10 and 12:13-25: he can describe God's greatness as well as his friends can.

decisions.choice: the spirits of the dead (B) / the dead (R)
decisions.reason: "Shades" is a rare word in modern English. Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1); Literal keeps "shades".

decisions.choice: "Vivuli [vya wafu]"
decisions.reason: "Vivuli" (shades) alone would not tell a Swahili reader that the dead are meant (meaning decision m1), so Literal adds "of the dead" in brackets; Balanced and Readable say "roho za wafu" and "wafu".

source.text: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Naked [is] Sheol before him, and there is not a covering for Abaddon.

en.L: Sheol [is] naked before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and there is no covering for Abaddon.
en.B: Sheol lies naked before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q Abaddon has no covering.
en.R: The grave is wide open to God. \q The place of destruction has nothing to hide it.

es.L: Desnudo [está] el Seol delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y no hay cobertura para el Abadón.
es.B: El lugar de los muertos yace desnudo delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q el Abadón no tiene cobertura.
es.R: El lugar de los muertos está abierto ante Dios. \q El lugar de la destrucción no tiene nada que lo esconda.

fr.L: Le Shéol [est] nu devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et il n’y a pas de voile pour l’Abaddon.
fr.B: Le séjour des morts est à nu devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q l’Abaddon n’a pas de voile.
fr.R: Le séjour des morts est grand ouvert devant Dieu. \q Le lieu de la destruction n’a rien pour se cacher.

sw.L: Kuzimu [iko] uchi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q wala hakuna kifuniko kwa Abadoni.
sw.B: Kuzimu iko wazi kabisa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q Abadoni haina kifuniko.
sw.R: Kuzimu iko wazi mbele za Mungu. \q Mahali pa uharibifu hapana kitu cha kupaficha.

vi.L: Âm Phủ trần trụi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và A-ba-đôn chẳng có gì che phủ.
vi.B: Âm Phủ phơi trần trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chốn hủy diệt chẳng có gì che đậy.
vi.R: Nơi của người chết mở toang trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. \q Chốn hủy diệt chẳng có gì che giấu được.

ko.L: 스올이 그분 앞에 벌거벗겨져 [있고], \q 아바돈에는 가리개가 없다.
ko.B: 스올이 그분 앞에 훤히 드러나 있고, \q 멸망의 자리도 가려지지 않는다.
ko.R: 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳도 하나님 앞에 활짝 열려 있다. \q 멸망의 자리도 숨을 곳이 없다.

pt.L: O Sheol [está] nu diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q e não há coberta para o Abadom.
pt.B: O mundo dos mortos está nu diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}; \q o Abadom não tem coberta.
pt.R: O mundo dos mortos está todo aberto aos olhos de Deus. \q O lugar da destruição não tem nada que o esconda.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the world of the dead, pictured as deep under the earth (7:9; 11:8; 17:13). It is the deepest and darkest place there is, and still it lies open to God's sight (Psalm 139:8; Proverbs 15:11).

decisions.choice: Abaddon: the place of destruction, another name for the realm of the dead
decisions.reason: Abaddon ('avaddon) comes from the verb "to perish" and means "destruction". In Job it stands beside Sheol and death as a name for the place of the dead (28:22; 31:12; compare Proverbs 15:11; Psalm 88:12). Revelation 9:11 later uses the name for the angel of the abyss. The name stays "Abaddon" at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: naked, no covering: fully seen by God
decisions.reason: Nothing hides the world of the dead from God; he sees it as plainly as an uncovered body (compare 24:7, where the same words describe the poor with no covering against the cold).

decisions.choice: the grave / the place of destruction
decisions.reason: Readable says "the grave" for Sheol and "the place of destruction" for Abaddon, as elsewhere in Job (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God so the reader knows who sees.

decisions.choice: o Abadom (L, B); o lugar da destruição (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 28:22; 31:12). The name is spelled as Portuguese writes its sounds, "Abadom", the form Revelation 9:11 uses in Portuguese for the angel who bears it, so the link m2 points to is kept. It takes the article as a place name, beside "o Sheol"; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. Sheol is "o Sheol" (L) and "o mundo dos mortos" (B, R), as in the rest of the book, also where the English Readable says "the grave".

source.text: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל־תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is] stretching out [the] north over emptiness, [he is] hanging [the] earth on nothing.

en.L: He stretches out [the] north over emptiness; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hangs [the] earth on nothing.
en.B: He stretches out the northern sky over empty space; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hangs the earth on nothing.
en.R: God spreads out the northern sky over empty space. \q He hangs the earth on nothing at all.

es.L: Extiende [el] norte sobre el vacío; \q cuelga [la] tierra sobre la nada.
es.B: Extiende el cielo del norte sobre el espacio vacío; \q cuelga la tierra sobre la nada.
es.R: Dios extiende el cielo del norte sobre el espacio vacío. \q Tiene la tierra colgada sin nada que la sostenga.

fr.L: Il étend [le] nord sur le vide ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} suspend [la] terre sur le néant.
fr.B: Il déploie le ciel du nord sur l’espace vide ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} suspend la terre sur le néant.
fr.R: Dieu étend le ciel du nord sur l’espace vide. \q Il suspend la terre sur rien du tout.

sw.L: Hutandaza kaskazini juu ya utupu; \q huitundika dunia juu ya si kitu.
sw.B: Hutandaza anga la kaskazini juu ya nafasi tupu; \q huitundika dunia juu ya si kitu.
sw.R: Mungu hutandaza anga la kaskazini juu ya nafasi tupu. \q Huitundika dunia bila kitu chochote cha kuishikilia.

vi.L: Ngài giăng [phương] bắc trên cõi trống không; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} treo đất trên chỗ không có gì.
vi.B: Ngài giăng bầu trời phương bắc trên khoảng không trống rỗng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} treo trái đất trên chỗ chẳng có gì.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời giăng bầu trời phương bắc trên khoảng không. \q Ngài treo trái đất mà chẳng cần vật gì đỡ cả.

ko.L: 그분은 북쪽을 빈 곳 위에 펼치시고, \q 땅을 아무것도 없는 것 위에 매다신다.
ko.B: 그분은 북쪽 하늘을 빈 공간 위에 펼치시고, \q 땅을 아무것도 없는 곳에 매달아 두신다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 북쪽 하늘을 빈 공간 위에 펼치신다. \q 아무것도 받치지 않는데도 땅을 매달아 두신다.

pt.L: Ele estende o norte sobre o vazio; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} suspende a terra sobre o nada.
pt.B: Ele estende o céu do norte sobre o espaço vazio; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} suspende a terra sobre o nada.
pt.R: Deus estende o céu do norte sobre o espaço vazio. \q Ele pendura a terra sobre coisa nenhuma.

decisions.choice: the north: the northern sky, or the high mountain of the north
decisions.reason: The word (tsafon) means the north. Here it is something God "stretches out" over the void, the verb used of spreading out the heavens like a tent (9:8; Isaiah 40:22). So it is most likely the northern sky. The north was also where the old poems placed the high mountain of the gods (Isaiah 14:13; Psalm 48:3), and that picture may lie behind the word.

decisions.choice: emptiness: the formless void
decisions.reason: The word (tohu) is the "formless" of Genesis 1:2: empty, shapeless space. God has set the heavens over it.

decisions.choice: hangs the earth on nothing: the earth needs no support but God
decisions.reason: "On not-anything" (beli mah) means on nothing at all. The point is God's power: the earth rests on nothing but his will. Elsewhere the Bible pictures the earth on foundations or pillars (9:6; 38:4-6); the poems use more than one picture, and this one stresses that nothing holds the world up except God.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God at the start of the hymn so the reader knows who is described.

records.literal_gloss: [He is] binding up waters in his clouds, and not is split open [the] cloud under them.

en.L: He binds up waters in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds, \q and [the] cloud does not split open under them.
en.B: He wraps up the waters in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds, \q yet the clouds do not burst under their weight.
en.R: He wraps up the rain in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds, \q and they do not burst open under all that water.

es.L: Ata las aguas en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes, \q y la nube no se rasga debajo de ellas.
es.B: Envuelve las aguas en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes, \q y las nubes no revientan bajo su peso.
es.R: Guarda la lluvia envuelta en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes, \q y ellas no revientan bajo tanta agua.

fr.L: Il enserre les eaux dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuées, \q et la nuée ne se fend pas sous elles.
fr.B: Il enveloppe les eaux dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuages, \q et les nuages ne crèvent pas sous leur poids.
fr.R: Il enferme la pluie dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuages, \q et ils ne crèvent pas sous toute cette eau.

sw.L: Huyafunga maji katika mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na wingu halipasuki chini ya [maji] hayo.
sw.B: Huyafunga maji ndani ya mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q lakini mawingu hayapasuki kwa uzito wake.
sw.R: Huifunga mvua ndani ya mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q nayo hayapasuki ingawa yamejaa maji mengi.

vi.L: Ngài gói nước lại trong mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và đám mây không bị xé ra bên dưới nước ấy.
vi.B: Ngài gói nước lại trong mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q thế mà mây không vỡ ra vì sức nặng.
vi.R: Ngài gói mưa lại trong mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q mà mây vẫn không vỡ dù chứa bao nhiêu nước.

ko.L: 그분은 물을 그분의 구름 속에 싸매시나, \q 구름이 그 아래에서 찢어지지 않는다.
ko.B: 그분은 물을 그분의 구름에 싸 두시니, \q 그 무게에도 구름이 터지지 않는다.
ko.R: 그분은 비를 구름 속에 싸 두신다. \q 그 많은 물에도 구름은 터지지 않는다.

pt.L: Ele amarra as águas nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} nuvens, \q e a nuvem não se rasga debaixo delas.
pt.B: Ele envolve as águas nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} nuvens, \q e as nuvens não se rompem com o peso delas.
pt.R: Ele guarda a chuva embrulhada nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} nuvens, \q e elas não estouram com toda aquela água.

decisions.choice: binds up waters in his clouds: holds the rain in the clouds like water in a skin
decisions.reason: The verb (tsarar) means to tie up in a bundle or bag (Proverbs 30:4: "who has bound up the waters in a garment?"). The clouds are pictured as water-skins that God fills (38:37). That such thin things hold so much water without tearing shows his power.

decisions.choice: under their weight
decisions.reason: "Under them" means under the waters they hold. Balanced says "under their weight" and Readable "under all that water" so the picture is clear.

records.literal_gloss: [He is] covering [the] face of [the] throne; he spreads over it his cloud.

en.L: He covers [the] face of [the] throne; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spreads {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cloud over it.
en.B: He veils the face of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne, \q spreading {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cloud over it.
en.R: He hides {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne from view \q by spreading {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} clouds over it.

es.L: Cubre [la] faz del trono; \q extiende sobre él {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nube.
es.B: Vela la faz de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono \q y extiende {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nube sobre él.
es.R: Esconde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono de la vista \q extendiendo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} nubes sobre él.

fr.L: Il couvre [la] face du trône ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} étend {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} nuée par-dessus.
fr.B: Il voile la face de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône \q en déployant par-dessus {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} nuée.
fr.R: Il cache {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône aux regards \q en étendant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} nuages par-dessus.

sw.L: Hufunika uso wa kiti cha enzi; \q hutandaza wingu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} juu yake.
sw.B: Hufunika uso wa kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi, \q akitandaza wingu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} juu yake.
sw.R: Huficha kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi kisionekane \q kwa kutandaza mawingu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yake.

vi.L: Ngài che phủ mặt của ngai; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trải mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên trên.
vi.B: Ngài che khuất mặt ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q trải mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phủ lên trên.
vi.R: Ngài che giấu ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi mắt người ta \q bằng cách trải mây của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phủ lên.

ko.L: 그분은 보좌의 표면을 덮으시고, \q 그 위에 그분의 구름을 펼치신다.
ko.B: 그분은 그분의 보좌 앞을 가리시고, \q 그 위에 구름을 펼치신다.
ko.R: 그분은 구름을 펼쳐서 \q 그분의 보좌를 보이지 않게 가리신다.

pt.L: Ele encobre a face do trono; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estende sobre ele a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} nuvem.
pt.B: Ele cobre com um véu a face do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono, \q estendendo sobre ele a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} nuvem.
pt.R: Ele esconde o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono da vista de todos, \q estendendo sobre ele as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} nuvens.

decisions.choice: the throne: God's throne in the heavens, hidden by cloud
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text points the word as "throne" (kisseh, here in an unusual spelling). God's throne is above the sky, and the clouds hide it from human eyes (22:13-14; Psalm 97:2). Spelled with the same letters but pointed differently, the word is "full moon" (Psalm 81:4; Proverbs 7:20), which also fits: God covers the face of the moon with cloud. This translation follows the pointing of the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: spreads: spreads out
decisions.reason: The verb form (parshez) is found only here; it is most likely a form of the common verb "to spread out" (parash).

decisions.choice: his throne
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "his throne", since it is God's throne in the heavens (m1); Literal keeps "the throne" as the Hebrew has it.

records.literal_gloss: A limit he has drawn as a circle on [the] face of [the] waters, to [the] end of light with darkness.

en.L: He has drawn a limit as a circle on [the] face of [the] waters, \q at [the] boundary of light with darkness.
en.B: He has marked out a circle on the face of the waters \q as a boundary between light and darkness.
en.R: He drew a circle on the surface of the sea \q to mark where light ends and darkness begins.

es.L: Ha trazado un límite en círculo sobre [la] faz de [las] aguas, \q en [el] confín de la luz con las tinieblas.
es.B: Ha trazado un círculo sobre la faz de las aguas \q como frontera entre la luz y las tinieblas.
es.R: Dibujó un círculo sobre la superficie del mar \q para marcar dónde termina la luz y comienza la oscuridad.

fr.L: Il a tracé une limite en cercle sur [la] face des eaux, \q à [la] frontière de la lumière avec les ténèbres.
fr.B: Il a tracé un cercle sur la face des eaux \q comme frontière entre la lumière et les ténèbres.
fr.R: Il a dessiné un cercle à la surface de la mer \q pour marquer où finit la lumière et où commence l’obscurité.

sw.L: Amechora mpaka kama duara juu ya uso wa maji, \q hadi mwisho wa nuru pamoja na giza.
sw.B: Amechora duara juu ya uso wa maji \q kuwa mpaka kati ya nuru na giza.
sw.R: Alichora duara juu ya uso wa bahari \q kuonyesha mahali nuru inapoishia na giza linapoanzia.

vi.L: Ngài đã vạch một giới hạn thành vòng tròn trên mặt nước, \q tại [nơi] tận cùng của ánh sáng với bóng tối.
vi.B: Ngài đã vạch một vòng tròn trên mặt nước \q làm ranh giới giữa ánh sáng và bóng tối.
vi.R: Ngài vẽ một vòng tròn trên mặt biển \q để đánh dấu nơi ánh sáng dừng lại và bóng tối bắt đầu.

ko.L: 그분은 물 표면 위에 경계를 원으로 그으셨으니, \q 빛이 어둠과 만나는 끝까지이다.
ko.B: 그분은 물 위에 원을 그어 \q 빛과 어둠의 경계로 삼으셨다.
ko.R: 그분은 바다 위에 둥근 선을 그으셔서 \q 빛이 끝나고 어둠이 시작되는 곳을 정하셨다.

pt.L: Ele traçou um limite em círculo sobre a face das águas, \q até o extremo da luz com as trevas.
pt.B: Ele traçou um círculo sobre a face das águas \q como divisa entre a luz e as trevas.
pt.R: Ele desenhou um círculo na superfície do mar \q para marcar onde a luz termina e a escuridão começa.

decisions.choice: a circle on the face of the waters: the horizon
decisions.reason: The picture is of God drawing a line round the edge of the world sea (Proverbs 8:27: "when he drew a circle on the face of the deep"). Where the sky meets the sea, at the horizon, is the edge of the world of light; beyond it lies darkness.

decisions.choice: a limit: a fixed boundary God has set
decisions.reason: The word (choq) means something laid down: a decree, a portion, or a boundary (14:5; 38:10). Here it is the limit God marked out, past which the light does not go.

decisions.choice: to the end of light with darkness: as far as the point where light meets darkness
decisions.reason: "The end of light with darkness" is the place where daylight stops and darkness starts, the edge of the circle.

decisions.choice: marked out a circle ... as a boundary
alternatives: drawn a limit as a circle
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "circle" first and turns "limit" into "boundary" in the second line, which is easier to follow in English.

records.literal_gloss: [The] pillars of heaven shake, and they are astounded at his rebuke.

en.L: [The] pillars of heaven shake, \q and they are astounded at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rebuke.
en.B: The pillars of heaven tremble \q and are stunned at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rebuke.
en.R: The pillars that hold up the sky shake. \q They are terrified when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shouts at them.

es.L: [Las] columnas del cielo se estremecen, \q y se pasman ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reprensión.
es.B: Las columnas del cielo tiemblan \q y quedan atónitas ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reprensión.
es.R: Las columnas que sostienen el cielo se sacuden. \q Se llenan de terror cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les grita.

fr.L: [Les] colonnes des cieux vacillent, \q et elles sont stupéfaites devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} menace.
fr.B: Les colonnes des cieux tremblent \q et sont frappées de stupeur devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} menace.
fr.R: Les colonnes qui soutiennent le ciel tremblent. \q Elles sont terrifiées quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} crie contre elles.

sw.L: Nguzo za mbingu zinatikisika, \q nazo zinashangaa kwa karipio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Nguzo za mbingu zinatetemeka \q na kuduwaa kwa karipio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Nguzo zinazoshikilia anga zinatikisika. \q Zinaogopa sana anapozikemea kwa sauti kuu.

vi.L: [Các] cột trụ của trời rung chuyển, \q và kinh hãi trước lời quở trách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Các cột trụ của trời run rẩy \q và sững sờ trước lời quở trách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những cột chống đỡ bầu trời rung chuyển. \q Chúng khiếp sợ khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quát lên với chúng.

ko.L: 하늘의 기둥들이 흔들리고, \q 그분의 꾸짖음에 놀란다.
ko.B: 하늘의 기둥들이 떨며 \q 그분의 꾸짖음에 아연실색한다.
ko.R: 하늘을 받치는 기둥들이 흔들린다. \q 그분께서 호통치시면 그것들이 겁에 질린다.

pt.L: As colunas dos céus estremecem \q e ficam atônitas com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} repreensão.
pt.B: As colunas dos céus tremem \q e ficam assombradas com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} repreensão.
pt.R: As colunas que sustentam o céu estremecem. \q Ficam apavoradas quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} grita com elas.

decisions.choice: the pillars of heaven: the great mountains thought to hold up the sky
decisions.reason: The poem pictures the sky as a vault resting on pillars at the edge of the earth, perhaps the high mountains on the horizon (compare 9:6, the pillars of the earth; 2 Samuel 22:8). When God speaks in anger, even what holds up the heavens shakes.

decisions.choice: rebuke: an angry shout, like thunder
decisions.reason: God's "rebuke" (ge'arah) is often a roar that drives back the sea and shakes the world (Psalm 18:16; 104:7; Isaiah 50:2). In storm it is heard as thunder (verse 14).

decisions.choice: when he shouts at them
decisions.reason: Readable says what a rebuke is here (m2).

source.text: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם וּ֝בִתְבוּנָת֗וֹ מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃

records.literal_gloss: By his power he stirred up the sea, and by his understanding he smashed Rahab.

en.L: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stirred up the sea, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} smashed Rahab.
en.B: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stirred up the sea; \q by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} skill {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} struck Rahab down.
en.R: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stirred up the sea. \q By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} crushed Rahab, the monster of the sea.

es.L: Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder agitó el mar, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} entendimiento destrozó a Rahab.
es.B: Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder agitó el mar; \q con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} destreza abatió a Rahab.
es.R: Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder agitó el mar. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría aplastó a Rahab, el monstruo del mar.

fr.L: Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a agité la mer, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fracassé Rahab.
fr.B: Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a soulevé la mer ; \q par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} habileté {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a abattu Rahab.
fr.R: Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a agité la mer. \q Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écrasé Rahab, le monstre de la mer.

sw.L: Kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliichafua bahari, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alimponda Rahabu.
sw.B: Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} aliichafua bahari; \q kwa ustadi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alimwangusha Rahabu.
sw.R: Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} aliichafua bahari. \q Kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} alimponda Rahabu, yule mnyama mkubwa wa baharini.

vi.L: Bởi quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khuấy động biển cả, \q và bởi sự hiểu biết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đập tan Ra-háp.
vi.B: Bằng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khuấy động biển cả; \q bằng tài khéo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh gục Ra-háp.
vi.R: Bằng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khuấy động biển cả. \q Bằng sự khôn ngoan của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiền nát Ra-háp, con quái vật biển.

ko.L: 그분은 그 능력으로 바다를 휘저으시고, \q 그 슬기로 라합을 쳐부수셨다.
ko.B: 그분은 능력으로 바다를 뒤흔드시고, \q 솜씨로 라합을 쳐 쓰러뜨리셨다.
ko.R: 그분은 능력으로 바다를 뒤흔드셨다. \q 지혜로 바다 괴물 라합을 짓부수셨다.

pt.L: Com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} agitou o mar, \q e com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} despedaçou Raabe.
pt.B: Com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} agitou o mar; \q com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} habilidade {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abateu Raabe.
pt.R: Com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} agitou o mar. \q Com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esmagou Raabe, o monstro do mar.

decisions.choice: stirred up: roused the sea
decisions.reason: The verb (raga') can mean to stir up (Isaiah 51:15; Jeremiah 31:35, both of God stirring up the sea so that its waves roar) or, in another use, to be at rest. Read the first way, God shows his power by rousing the sea; read the second, by bringing it to stillness. Both show that the sea is under his control, and the second line goes on to his victory over the sea monster.

decisions.choice: Rahab: the sea monster of chaos (9:13)
decisions.reason: On Rahab see 9:13. In the old poems God defeated the monster of the sea at the beginning (Psalm 89:11; Isaiah 51:9). Here Job sets Rahab beside the sea itself: God masters the raging deep.

decisions.choice: understanding: God's skill and insight
decisions.reason: God's "understanding" (tevunah) is the skilled wisdom by which he made and orders the world (Proverbs 3:19; Jeremiah 10:12). It is set beside his power.

decisions.choice: the monster of the sea
decisions.reason: Readable adds who Rahab is (m2), so the reader does not think of Rahab of Jericho.

decisions.choice: Raabe (every level); "Raabe, o monstro do mar" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 9:13. The sea monster of chaos (m2) has the same Hebrew name in Portuguese spelling as the woman of Jericho, "Raabe" (Joshua 2:1), but the two names are different words in Hebrew: the monster's means "arrogance, raging", hers "wide". Portuguese keeps the one familiar form, as the English keeps "Rahab", and Readable adds who is meant, as the English Readable does, so that no reader thinks of Rahab of Jericho. A translation of the name ("o Orgulhoso") would lose the link with Psalm 89:11 and Isaiah 51:9, where the same monster is named.

source.text: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: By his wind [the] heavens [are] clearness; it pierced, his hand, [the] serpent fleeing.

en.L: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind [the] heavens [are] fair; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
en.B: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} breath the skies became clear; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
en.R: He breathed, and the sky was clear again. \q With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hand {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stabbed the serpent as it tried to escape.

es.L: Por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento [los] cielos [quedan] despejados; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano traspasó a la serpiente huidiza.
es.B: Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} aliento los cielos quedaron despejados; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano traspasó a la serpiente huidiza.
es.R: Sopló, y el cielo volvió a quedar despejado. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia mano hirió a la serpiente cuando intentaba escapar.

fr.L: Par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent [les] cieux [sont] limpides ; \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main a transpercé le serpent fuyant.
fr.B: Par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} souffle le ciel est devenu clair ; \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main a transpercé le serpent fuyant.
fr.R: Il a soufflé, et le ciel est redevenu clair. \q De {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre main {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a transpercé le serpent qui cherchait à s’enfuir.

sw.L: Kwa upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mbingu [ni] safi; \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulimchoma nyoka akimbiaye.
sw.B: Kwa pumzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} anga likawa safi; \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulimchoma nyoka akimbiaye.
sw.R: Alipuliza, na anga likawa safi tena. \q Kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe alimchoma nyoka alipojaribu kutoroka.

vi.L: Bởi gió của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [các] tầng trời [trở nên] quang đãng; \q tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đâm thủng con rắn đang chạy trốn.
vi.B: Bởi hơi thở của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, bầu trời trở nên quang đãng; \q tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đâm thủng con rắn đang chạy trốn.
vi.R: Ngài thở ra, và bầu trời lại quang đãng. \q Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đâm con rắn khi nó tìm cách trốn thoát.

ko.L: 그분의 바람으로 하늘이 맑아지고, \q 그분의 손이 도망치는 뱀을 찔렀다.
ko.B: 그분의 숨결로 하늘이 맑게 개고, \q 그분의 손이 달아나는 뱀을 꿰뚫었다.
ko.R: 그분께서 숨을 내쉬시니 하늘이 다시 맑아졌다. \q 그분께서 손수, 달아나려는 뱀을 찌르셨다.

pt.L: Pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} vento os céus [ficam] serenos; \q a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão traspassou a serpente veloz.
pt.B: Pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} sopro os céus ficaram límpidos; \q a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão traspassou a serpente veloz.
pt.R: Ele soprou, e o céu ficou limpo de novo. \q Com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria mão {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} feriu a serpente veloz quando ela tentava fugir.

decisions.choice: wind: God's wind or breath
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) means wind, breath or spirit. In this storm scene it is most likely the wind God sends, which sweeps the clouds away and leaves the sky clear (37:21). "His breath" says the same thing in the language of a person: God breathes and the storm clears.

decisions.choice: clearness: fair, bright sky
decisions.reason: The word (shifrah) is found only here and comes from a root meaning to be fair or bright. The heavens become clear after the storm.

decisions.choice: the fleeing serpent: the sea monster, also called Leviathan
decisions.reason: Isaiah 27:1 calls Leviathan "the fleeing serpent" and says God will punish it with his sword. The fleeing serpent here is the same chaos monster as Rahab in verse 12 and Leviathan in 3:8. Some think of a serpent seen in the stars, swept from sight by the storm, but the parallel with Isaiah makes the sea monster more likely.

decisions.choice: breath (B) / breathed (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "breath", which keeps the link between God's wind and his breath (m1); Literal says "wind".

decisions.choice: as it tried to escape
decisions.reason: Readable says what "fleeing" means here: the monster was trying to get away.

decisions.choice: a serpente veloz
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word describes the monster as fleeing or gliding away (m3), the title Isaiah 27:1 gives Leviathan. "Veloz" keeps it a title, the way Portuguese readers know the phrase from Isaiah 27:1, and suits a serpent that slips away; Readable adds "quando ela tentava fugir", as the English Readable says "as it tried to escape", so the sense of flight is not lost.

source.text: הֶן־אֵ֤לֶּה׀קְצ֬וֹת דְּרָכָ֗יו וּמַה־שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע־בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גְּ֝בוּרוֹתָ֗יומִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Look, these [are the] edges of his ways, and what a whisper of a word we hear of him! And the thunder of his mighty deeds, who will understand?

en.L: Look, these [are the] edges of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, \q and what a whisper of a word we hear of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q But the thunder of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty deeds, who can understand?
en.B: Look, these are only the outer edges of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways; \q how faint the whisper we hear of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q But the thunder of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, who can understand it?
en.R: And these are only the edges of what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does. \q We hear only a whisper about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Who could ever understand {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty power, which is like thunder?

es.L: Mira, estos [son los] bordes de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, \q ¡y qué susurro de palabra oímos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! \q Pero el trueno de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} proezas, ¿quién [lo] podrá entender?
es.B: Mira, estos son solo los bordes de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos; \q ¡qué débil es el susurro que oímos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! \q Pero el trueno de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, ¿quién lo puede entender?
es.R: Y estos son solo los bordes de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace. \q De {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} solo oímos un susurro. \q ¿Quién podría jamás entender {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder, que es como un trueno?

fr.L: Voici, ce [sont les] bords de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies, \q et quel murmure de parole nous entendons de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! \q Mais le tonnerre de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits, qui peut [le] comprendre ?
fr.B: Voici, ce ne sont que les bords de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies ; \q qu’il est faible, le murmure que nous percevons de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! \q Mais le tonnerre de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, qui peut le comprendre ?
fr.R: Et ce n’est là que le bord de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait. \q Nous n’entendons de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’un murmure. \q Qui pourrait jamais comprendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, qui est comme le tonnerre ?

sw.L: Tazama, hizi [ni] kingo za njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q na ni mnong'ono gani wa neno tunaousikia juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}! \q Lakini ngurumo ya matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} makuu, ni nani awezaye kuielewa?
sw.B: Tazama, hizi ni kingo tu za njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q jinsi ulivyo dhaifu mnong'ono tunaousikia juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}! \q Lakini ngurumo ya uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ni nani awezaye kuielewa?
sw.R: Na haya ni ukingo tu wa kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Tunasikia mnong'ono tu juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Ni nani angeweza kamwe kuelewa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu, ulio kama ngurumo?

vi.L: Kìa, đây [là] những bờ mép của các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và chúng ta nghe về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một lời thì thầm nhỏ nhẹ biết bao! \q Còn tiếng sấm của các việc quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ai có thể hiểu được?
vi.B: Kìa, đó chỉ là ven rìa các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q tiếng thì thầm chúng ta nghe về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới mờ nhạt làm sao! \q Còn tiếng sấm quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ai hiểu thấu được?
vi.R: Những điều ấy chỉ là phần rìa của những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm. \q Chúng ta chỉ nghe được một tiếng thì thầm về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ai có thể hiểu nổi quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như tiếng sấm rền?

ko.L: 보라, 이것들은 그분의 길의 끝자락이요, \q 우리가 그분에게서 듣는 것은 얼마나 작은 속삭임인가! \q 그러나 그분의 능하신 일들의 우렛소리를 누가 깨달을 수 있으랴?
ko.B: 보라, 이것들은 그분의 길의 끝자락일 뿐이다. \q 우리가 그분에 대해 듣는 속삭임은 얼마나 희미한가! \q 그러나 그분의 능력의 우렛소리를 누가 깨달을 수 있겠는가?
ko.R: 이것들은 그분께서 하시는 일의 한 자락일 뿐이다. \q 우리는 그분에 대해 겨우 속삭임만 들을 뿐이다. \q 천둥과 같은 그분의 크신 능력을 누가 다 깨달을 수 있겠는가?

pt.L: Eis que estas [são as] bordas dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos, \q e que sussurro de palavra ouvimos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}! \q Mas o trovão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} feitos poderosos, quem o entenderá?
pt.B: Pois estas são apenas as bordas dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos; \q como é fraco o sussurro que ouvimos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}! \q Mas o trovão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder, quem pode entendê-lo?
pt.R: E isso é só a beirada do que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz. \q Ouvimos apenas um sussurro a respeito {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Quem conseguiria entender o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder, que é como um trovão?

decisions.choice: the edges of his ways: only the outskirts of what God does
decisions.reason: The word (qetsot) means the ends or fringes of something. All that Job has described, the deep, the sky, the sea, is only the outer edge of God's works (compare Proverbs 8:22, where wisdom is the beginning of his way).

decisions.choice: a whisper of a word: a faint sound, as against thunder
decisions.reason: The word (shemets) means a whisper or faint trace (4:12). What humans hear of God is only a whisper; the full "thunder" of his might is beyond them.

decisions.choice: the thunder of his mighty deeds: the full force of God's power
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the reading tradition (qere) differ slightly here, between "his might" and "his mighty deeds"; the sense is the same, and Balanced says "his power". Thunder is the loudest sound people know, and it stands for the full display of God's power, which no one can take in. The book returns to this in God's speech from the storm (chapters 38-41).

decisions.choice: Who could ever understand his mighty power, which is like thunder?
alternatives: the thunder of his mighty deeds, who will understand?
decisions.reason: Readable puts the question first and explains the picture of thunder as a comparison.
